content.title: How to Watch Diamondbacks vs. Phillies: TV Channel & Live Stream - April 11
content.text: One of baseball's most exciting matchups heads to the City of Brotherly Love when Arizona Diamondbacks take on the Philadelphia Phillies on Saturday, April 11, 2026 at 1:00 PM ET on FS1 from Citizens Bank Park in Philadelphia, PA.The Diamondbacks have been a dynamic offensive club, bringing their run-scoring attack into every series as one of the National League's most competitive squads. Arizona's offense has the firepower to challenge any pitching staff, while their defense has shown the ability to keep games close and give their bullpen a chance to shut down opposing lineups late in games.The Phillies, playing at home at Citizens Bank Park, are one of the NL's most dangerous teams when the crowd is behind them. Philadelphia's lineup is loaded with proven run producers and their rotation has the depth to compete in any series.
